e.title: VMTK (GEM 脆弱性建模工具包)
e.summary: GEM 全球地震模型基金会脆弱性建模工具包（35★）：脆弱性/易损性曲线创建与数据管理
e.body: VMTK-Vulnerability-Modellers-ToolKit（GEM Foundation，35★）是 GEM（全球地震模型基金会）的脆弱性建模工具包：支持创建与管理脆弱性（vulnerability）与易损性模型/曲线——GEM 风险计算中暴露-脆弱性层的关键工具。对 RIAA：脆弱性曲线的方法论参考（与 [[openquake-engine]] 的工程计算方法配套）——理解灾损率/脆弱性函数怎么从数据与专家判断构建；[[risk-data-library-standard]] 语境下的脆弱性数据结构。

e.title_hk: VMTK (GEM 脆弱性建模工具包)
e.summary_en: GEM Foundation toolkit for vulnerability modelling (35★): creation and data management of vulnerability curves/models
e.summary_hk: GEM 全球地震模型基金會脆弱性建模工具包（35★）：脆弱性/易損性曲線創建與數據管理
e.body_en: VMTK-Vulnerability-Modellers-ToolKit (GEM Foundation, 35★) is GEM's (Global Earthquake Model Foundation) vulnerability modelling toolkit: it supports creating and managing vulnerability models/curves — the key exposure-vulnerability layer in GEM risk computation. For RIAA: a methodological reference for vulnerability curves (paired with the engineering-computation side of [[openquake-engine]]) — understanding how damage/loss ratios and vulnerability functions are built from data and expert judgement; vulnerability data structure in the [[risk-data-library-standard]] context.
e.body_hk: VMTK-Vulnerability-Modellers-ToolKit（GEM Foundation，35★）是 GEM（全球地震模型基金會）的脆弱性建模工具包：支持創建與管理脆弱性（vulnerability）與易損性模型/曲線——GEM 風險計算中暴露-脆弱性層的關鍵工具。對 RIAA：脆弱性曲線的方法論參考（與 [[openquake-engine]] 的工程計算方法配套）——理解災損率/脆弱性函數怎麼從數據與專家判斷構建；[[risk-data-library-standard]] 語境下的脆弱性數據結構。
